name: RC-B10-0357/2026 – After recital D – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text: Da. whereas, on 6 July 2026, following the urgent debate held on 3 July 2026 on the situation in El-Obeid, the UN Human Rights Council requested that the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission for the Sudan conduct an ‘urgent investigation’ into alleged violations of international law and international crimes committed in the region;
